summary: A four-track groovebox modelled on a small band: lead, pads, bass and drums, each with its own patterns, pedal effects and arrangement in a song sequencer.
features: LEAD and PAD 4 voices each, plus BASS and DRUMS tracks
10 patterns per track, 16 to 64 steps; step and live recording
10 tweakable sounds per instrument; 10 drum kits incl. sampled LM-1
Five stompbox pedals per track, arpeggiator and mixer with mutes
SUPER SEQ chains patterns per track into 10 songs
4 save slots plus autosave; USB rescue by holding OCT-
